CREATE TABLE rule_versions (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  plan_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('weekday_mask', 'weekly_target', 'end_on', 'due_on')),

    ELSE 0 END)
) STRICT
